messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a concise list of the **long‑weekend holidays that occur in Canada during 2023**.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a three‑day stretch that includes a statutory holiday and at least one weekend day (Saturday or Sunday).  The table shows the holiday name, the date it falls on in 2023, the weekend days that are part of the long weekend, and a short note about any provincial variations.

| # | Holiday | 2023 Date | Weekend Days Included | Notes |
|---|---------|-----------|-----------------------|-------|
| 1 | **New Year’s Day** | **Sunday, Jan 1** | Sat Dec 31 – Mon Jan 2 | Creates a 3‑day weekend that spills over from 2022. |
| 2 | **Family Day** (Ontario, New Brunswick, Manitoba, Saskatchewan) | **Monday, Feb 20** | Sat Feb 18 – Mon Feb 20 | Long weekend for those provinces. |
| 3 | **Good Friday** | **Friday, Apr 7** | Fri Apr 7 – Sun Apr 9 | 3‑day weekend. |
| 4 | **Victoria Day** | **Monday, May 22** | Sat May 20 – Mon May 22 | 3‑day weekend. |
| 5 | **Canada Day** | **Saturday, Jul 1** | Sat Jul 1 – Mon Jul 3 | 3‑day weekend (includes the following Monday). |
| 6 | **Labour Day** | **Monday, Sep 4** | Sat Sep 2 – Mon Sep 4 | 3‑day weekend. |
| 7 | **Thanksgiving** | **Monday, Oct 9** | Sat Oct 7 – Mon Oct 9 | 3‑day weekend. |
| 8 | **Remembrance Day** | **Saturday, Nov 11** | Sat Nov 11 – Mon Nov 13 | 3‑day weekend (includes the following Monday). |
| 9 | **Christmas Day** | **Monday, Dec 25** | Sat Dec 23 – Mon Dec 25 | 3‑day weekend. |

### Provincial / Territorial Variations

| Province/Territory | Additional Long‑Weekend Holiday in 2023 |
|--------------------|----------------------------------------|
| **Alberta** | **St. John’s Day** – Monday, Feb 20 (same as Family Day) |
| **British Columbia** | **St. John’s Day** – Monday, Feb 20 (same as Family Day) |
| **Newfoundland & Labrador** | **St. John’s Day** – Monday, Feb 20 (same as Family Day) |
| **Quebec** | **Saint‑Jean‑Baptiste Day** – Monday, Jun 24 (creates a 3‑day weekend: Sat Jun 22 – Mon Jun 24) |
| **Nova Scotia** | **St. John’s Day** – Monday, Feb 20 (same as Family Day) |
| **Prince Edward Island** | **St. John’s Day** – Monday, Feb 20 (same as Family Day) |
| **Yukon** | **St. John’s Day** – Monday, Feb 20 (same as Family Day) |
| **Northwest Territories** | **St. John’s Day** – Monday, Feb 20 (same as Family Day) |
| **Nunavut** | **St. John’s Day** – Monday, Feb 20 (same as Family Day) |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> - If you need to support all provinces/territories, consider storing a mapping of holiday names to dates per region.  
> - For holidays that fall on a weekend, Canada observes the holiday on the nearest weekday (e.g., if a holiday falls on a Sunday, it is observed on Monday). This rule is already reflected in the dates above (e.g., New Year’s Day on Sunday, Jan 1 is observed on Monday, Jan 2).

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the same information for other years or additional details such as the exact dates for provincial holidays that differ from the federal schedule.
